title: Head of Customer Experience & Retention

Who we are
Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people globally.
Why we are hiring
Most of our revenue comes from subscribers, so how long people stay with us matters as much as how many we acquire. Today retention is split between the founders, our support team and a set of tools that nobody owns end to end. We want one person who owns the whole customer experience after the first click: the website, the package that arrives, the emails and messages in between, and the reasons people stay or leave.
We consider this the most revenue-critical seat in the company. The founders will be in the room from the first conversation, and whoever takes it will have their full backing and budget to build the function properly.
You would report to our co-founder who runs operations and work closely with our CMO and co-founder on messaging. The Shopify developer and the web and brand designer we are hiring at the same time will report to you.
What you will own

• Retention, end to end. Repeat purchase rate and subscription retention, especially in months two and three, are your numbers.

• The retention tools we already have, and the ones we are missing. Keep what works working, improve it, and build what is not there yet, starting with a loyalty program.

• Every customer touchpoint. Review the full customer journey, from the website to the package to everything post-purchase, and make it coherent: same message, same brand, no gaps.

• The website as an experience. A Shopify developer and a web and brand designer work under you to keep the site consistent and ship the changes you prioritise.

• Our community. Grow our Facebook community of Flow customers and make it part of why people stay.

• The numbers. A clear weekly view of retention, repeat purchase and the metrics our support team reports, so the founders know where we stand.

Customer support (reps, refunds, chargebacks) has its own lead and keeps running as it does today; over time that team will sit under you. • flexibles Zusatzeinkommen mit hohem Entwicklungspotential ohne Investitionsbedarf

• professioneller technischer und administrativer Support

• weitreichende Unterstützung mit wissenschaftlichen Studien und Informationen zur Behandlung mit Medizinal-Cannabis

• Consultation mit anderen Ärzten die konsilarisch zur Seite stehen

• Remote working, hohe Vereinbarkeit mit Hauptjob und Familie

• Entwicklung auf Vollzeit möglich

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

You'll be accountable for the speed and quality of your teams' decisions, and for aligning stakeholders (Engineering, Business Analysts, Data Science, Design, Customer Service) around goals that maximize impact. Open roles span squads such as Mass Market, Investments, AXP and Nuconta.

- Diving deep into user behavior by talking to real customers, analyzing data and seeing products used in the real world.

- Partnering with Engineering, Business Analysts, Data Science and Design to define, iterate and ship sustainable products.

- Ensuring robust technical foundations that let Nubank scale in users, products and countries.

- Aligning stakeholders on team goals and defining the success factors of a world-class product management discipline.

- Staying current on finance and tech innovation, helping the team understand where the company and the market are going.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

- Hands-on experience as a Product Manager across the full product life-cycle of successful tech products.

- Experience making data-driven decisions and prioritizing impact.

- Experience building strong relationships and communicating clearly across distinct stakeholders.

- Good understanding of the software development lifecycle.

- Fluent English.

Nice to have

- Experience with customer-facing products (those directly related to the final customer).

Bogotá, Colombia

About CourseCareers

CourseCareers is an online education platform that helps people launch new careers without a college degree or prior experience .
We work with industry professionals to create job-focused courses that teach practical, employer-aligned skills in technology, business, trades, and operations. Our students are career changers looking for realistic, entry-level opportunities - and coaching helps bridge the gap between coursework and landing the job.
About the Role
We’re looking for part-time Career Coaches to support students through live workshops and optional 1:1 coaching.
This is not a traditional employment role and not a guaranteed-income position. It’s a flexible, paid opportunity best suited for professionals who want to mentor, teach, and build a small coaching practice on the side - with upside if students choose to work with you.
How This Role Actually Works

• You host a live, one-hour workshop (seminar-style) for students

• You are paid $50 for your workshop + Private business you acquire

• Ability to receive exclusive coaching offers if you prove your abilities

• Workshops are used to provide value, answer questions, and showcase your expertise

• If students choose to book you for 1:1 coaching, you keep the coaching revenue

• You set your own availability and working hours

There is no requirement to convert students, workshops are paid regardless, but conversion is where upside comes from.
Responsibilities

• Host a live, one-hour workshop, on a monthly basis

• Answer student questions related to the field and job search

• Share real-world insight into what entry-level roles actually look like

• Provide optional 1:1 coaching to students who request it

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of professional experience in the field

• Interest in mentoring and helping career changers

• Strong communication and teaching ability

• Availability at least three evening per week , ideally Tuesday-Thursday

• Self-starter mindset - comfortable running your own workshops

Ideal Fit
This role is a great fit if you:

• Enjoy teaching and mentoring

• Want flexible, side income

• Like the idea of being paid to teach - with optional upside

• Don’t need guaranteed hours or full-time income

Compensation

• $50 per one-hour workshop (guaranteed)

• Unlimited upside from 1:1 coaching sessions you convert

• No caps, no quotas, no minimums
